title: Why he hired modern players
summary: Cootie liked modern jazz players who were breaking new ground, including Bud Powell and Charlie Parker.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Yeah. I see. But then, for soloists you'd -- well, how come you -- I mean, Joe Guy was a modernist, wasn't he?
But you hired him because you felt that he had something there? He was working something out? You were interested in what he played?
Oh. Could -- because you could see they were breaking new fields?
Well, it's self-evident you did since you hired Bud Powell, and you hired Charlie Parker. And -- Monk never worked in the band did he?
No. If he did, he wasn't there for a long period of time.
